definitions: Go down below the surface of something, especially water.
Descend or cause to descend gradually.
Decrease in amount, extent, or intensity.
Invest money in something with the expectation of profit or benefit.
Score a goal or pot a ball in games like snooker.
examples: He watched the sun sink below the horizon.
Her voice sank to a whisper.
They sank a lot of money into the project.
He managed to sink the black ball.
